hooks.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); if [ -z "$cwd" ]; then exit 0; fi; git -C "$cwd" fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null || exit 0; branch=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if [ "$branch" != "main" ]; then exit 0; fi; dirty=$(git -C "$cwd" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then exit 0; fi; git -C "$cwd" merge --ff-only origin/main --quiet 2>/dev/null; exit 0

hooks.statusMessage: Bootstrapping web session (PATH, lint/proto tools, local Postgres, npm install)...

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[^a-zA-Z])(grep|rg)([^a-zA-Z]|$)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'ast-grep' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -Eiq '\.(md|json|ya?ml|txt|log)([^a-zA-Z]|$)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '\|[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(grep|rg)([^a-zA-Z]|$)'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: CLAUDE.md rule - prefer ast-grep over grep/rg for code searches. Only use grep/rg for non-code files (logs, configs, docs)."}}'; fi

printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: CLAUDE.md rule - prefer ast-grep for code searches. Only use the Grep tool for non-code files (logs, configs, docs)."}}'

input=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); if [ -z "$cwd" ] || [ -z "$fp" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$cwd" in */.claude/worktrees/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; repo_root="${cwd%%/.claude/worktrees/*}"; rest="${cwd#*/.claude/worktrees/}"; wt="${rest%%/*}"; wt_root="$repo_root/.claude/worktrees/$wt"; case "$fp" in "$wt_root"|"$wt_root"/*) exit 0 ;; "$repo_root"/*) jq -n --arg fp "$fp" --arg root "$wt_root" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Refusing to write to " + $fp + ": outside the active worktree for this session (" + $root + "). Edit the file inside the worktree, not the main checkout or another worktree.")}}'; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Checking edit target stays inside the active worktree...

hooks.command: printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: approving a plan does NOT start the task. Run the start-task skill now - a fresh worktree off latest main, plus a tracking issue with this approved plan recorded in its ## Plan section - BEFORE the first edit. When the work is done, run finish-task (lint, coverage, build, PR, CI). Opening the PR is standing pre-authorized workflow here and does not need to be requested."}}'
